attested.notes: Stranger read run by a fresh agent with no knowledge of the drafting session; five real problems found and all fixed before this pass was recorded. (1) The reader could not parse the 712/620-day table cell after three attempts; it now reads 'half took longer than 712 days from appointment to the company being struck off'. (2) They did not know which route was theirs, because the page never said; a three-item list now identifies the reader's own situation before any number appears. (3) They nearly closed the tab at 'closer to two years'; the reassurance that the second timescale is the liquidator's rather than theirs now sits immediately after it. (4) 'Conduct investigation' was unexplained and worried them most; both instances are now plain English. (5) Nothing acknowledged their situation, answered with a sourced fact rather than sympathy: 18,525 CVLs in 2025. Also demoted the not-comparable caveat, which the reader explicitly did not care about.
